manifestations.description: had to walk on a crutch for more than a year
urinary leakage (bedwetting); has to wear diapers at night
sexual dysfunction; has not had sex with his wife after the Accident
loss of appetite and weight reduced from 130 odd to 110 pounds
fatigue and loss of concentration (side effects of psychiatric medication)

treatments_received: psychiatric treatments at Yung Fung Shee Psychiatric Clinic
treatments_future: further physiotherapy course referred later this year

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Has not had sexual life with his wife; whenever attempts made his waist became painful and he had to abandon the acts.
Reduced from a respectable police officer to indoor clerical duties; lost a job he enjoyed and was looked down upon by colleagues.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Before the Accident he was physically fit and active; now he cannot do exercises.
Cannot take his children out; marital relationship has deteriorated greatly; loses his temper easily.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Cannot help his wife to do household chores.
